decisions.reason: Bowl cleaning or removability does not change the splash-control requirement; its independent splash-related changes from message 61 are already represented.
The candidate already requires the spout to be removable or easy to clean, while the source Event adds cleaning access specifically to the bowl-removal requirement.
Bowl cleaning or removability does not alter the required matcha texture or mixing quality; message 61's independent texture change is already represented.
The cleaning-access decision does not necessarily change any BOM deliverable or component-selection criterion.
Bowl cleaning access does not change the valve mechanism, dispensing sequence, closed-valve behavior, or controlled-flow requirement.
Making bowls easy to clean or removable does not change their selected capacity, depth, size reference, or form.
Cleaning or removability of bowls does not alter the spout's geometry, construction, appearance, location, or orientation.
Bowl cleaning access does not change whisk size, style, material, or bowl compatibility; the whisk discussion in the same message is an independent decision.
The cleaning-access decision has no effect on the machine's beige and green color scheme.
Ease of bowl cleaning or removal does not modify the separately stated requirement that liquid must not leak into the base or electronics.
The cleaning-access decision does not affect the machine name, retained wording, or placard placement.
Requesting easy bowl cleaning or removal does not necessarily alter the V1 sourcing policy or rapid-prototype priority.
